name: Rosy Evening-primrose
desc: Rosy Evening-primrose (Oenothera rosea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Oenothera rosea, also known as rosy evening-primrose, rose evening primrose, pink evening primrose, or Rose of Mexico, is a species of flowering plant in the family Onagraceae.
